historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED / CHANGED for missing challenge protocol, crypto, identity, replay/expiry, redaction and cleanup.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: Active Session and privilege cases do not define this handshake.

original_test_intent: Validate a BMC authentication-session challenge flow without exposing reusable material or leaving unintended session state.
original_method: Do not send a guessed challenge; require vendor protocol, dedicated identity, crypto/nonce/expiry semantics, protected evidence and cleanup.
manual_activity: Vendor and security owner define the handshake and approve an isolated identity; operator verifies protected access and cleanup before any future run.
agent_execution_scope: After approval run one bounded handshake

command_applicability.command_recommendation: None until the vendor/security runbook is approved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use one isolated account and exact protected challenge flow, validate nonce/crypto/expiry/replay without logging secrets, then verify cleanup/audit state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds missing security contract without changing Master.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Guessing can expose authentication material or allocate replayable sessions.

project_override_considerations: No tool override is equivalent until it implements the same approved challenge and crypto semantics.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title names a security handshake but Procedure and Criteria are TBD; the generic clear-log step would destroy required audit evidence.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Protocol and cryptographic semantics are the core test, not missing runtime parameters; inventing them is unsafe.

review_improvement: Prevents guessed authentication traffic, credential exposure and false PASS from a transport response.
independent_technical_reasoning: A session challenge can create state and expose reusable authentication material. With no method, schema or criteria, safe execution and acceptance cannot be derived, so engineer/security ownership is mandatory.
